book.name: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content: Maaron ileep tomani ghiit ve iŋginŋgin ghiit
Mbouŋ to yes tau tizala Yerusalem pa suŋuuŋ

content.text: Matag izala pa loloz naghe naghita:
Yoova mon ta pale nagham uleeŋ ila tooni.
I ta ighur sambam ve taan.
I aat maata payo. Irau ipul ghom aghem pusukia ve utap mako.
Onoon kat, ŋginiiŋ to iit Israela, ighe maata ighengheen, ene irau igheen mako.
Yoova maata payo ve iŋgin ghom, leso uleep poi.
I ileep ila zigem, ve imin yavyaav payo to ipoon ghom pa aaz.
Tauvene mataaz, aaz irau ighaaz katin ghom mako.
Ve mboŋ, kaiyo irau ivaghamun ghom mako.
Yoova aat maata payo, ve ipoon ghom pa gabua sasaghati naol isov.
I tauu pale iŋgin ghom uleep poi.
I pale maata pa laghooŋ tsio ve lepoogh tsio. Tauvene saawe tau upul ruum ve uvot ula, le umuul uloŋ ulam, i pale ileep tomani ghom, ve iŋgin ghom uleep poi.
Ta aazne, ve taghon taghon gha ila.
